commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-<empty>} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-<empty>} ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-<empty>}"; echo "---"; mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/local-review; gh pr diff 1639 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/local-review/diff.patch | head -5; echo "diff-lines:"; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/local-review/diff.patch

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31576746853-1; gh pr diff 1639 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31576746853-1/diff.patch >/dev/null; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31576746853-1/diff.patch; echo "---files---"; grep '^diff --git' .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1639/31576746853-1/diff.patch

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" && git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
